question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.
sql:
-- Use CAST to ensure integer types instead of floats
WITH RECURSIVE months AS (
    SELECT DATE '2020-01-01' as month_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month_date + INTERVAL '1' MONTH
    FROM months
    WHERE month_date < DATE '2020-04-01'
),
all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_months AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month_date
    FROM all_customers c
    CROSS JOIN months m
),
monthly_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
           strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as month,
           CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount
                WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                ELSE 0 END as net_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT cm.customer_id, 
           strftime('%Y-%m', cm.month_date) as month,
           COALESCE(SUM(mn.net_amount), 0) as monthly_change
    FROM customer_months cm
    LEFT JOIN monthly_net mn ON cm.customer_id = mn.customer_id 
        AND strftime('%Y-%m', mn.txn_date) = strftime('%Y-%m', cm.month_date)
    GROUP BY cm.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', cm.month_date)
),
with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           month, 
           monthly_change,
           SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as closing_balance
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT customer_id,
       month,
       CAST(monthly_change AS BIGINT) as monthly_change,
       CAST(closing_balance AS BIGINT) as closing_balance
FROM with_cumulative
ORDER BY customer_id, month
LIMIT 15
